Alyssa — thanks for the note. High level below and attached is the runbook PDF + artifact template. Quick summary of acceptance criteria we propose for the witness run (you can push back if SpeedPay has different constraints):

Acceptance criteria (witness run):
- Functional correctness: pass 99% of the golden prompt checks (we'll provide 2k sample prompts).
- Latency: p50 < 120ms, p90 < 200ms, p99 < 320ms for token generation on the test model under steady-state load.
- Throughput: sustained 1,000 RPS with 95% success rate during 15-minute steady windows; burst capacity at 2,500 RPS for 3 minutes must not drop below 90% success rate.
- Tail behavior: no more than 0.5% of requests experiencing > 1s latency during the entire run.
- Error budget: cumulative error rate <= 2% across the full run (includes 5xx and model-errors).

Run structure we recommend (see attached runbook):
1) Pre-warm (30m): KV cache population using representative prefixes + low concurrency ramp to populate caches.
2) Baseline functional sweep (1h): run the golden prompts at low concurrency to validate outputs and measure correctness.
3) Steady-state throughput (3x 15m windows): ramp to 1k RPS, hold 15m, collect traces, then cool-down.
4) Burst tests (x3): short 3-minute bursts to 2.5k RPS to validate autoscale/fallback behavior.
5) Tail-latency soak (30m): moderate concurrency with injected long-prompts to exercise KV eviction paths.
6) Witness run (1h): joint run with SpeedPay observers and Redwood witness; collection of artifacts and hashes for immutability.

Artifacts we need back after the witness run:
- CSV of per-request latencies (timestamp, request_id, model_variant, prompt_id, latency_ms, status)
- Aggregated percentile tables (p50/p90/p95/p99) and throughput time-series
- Server-side GC/GPUs utilization logs and a short flamegraph sampling (optional)
- Checksums for any zipped artifact bundle

I've attached: 1) 2025-05-15_SpeedPay_SLA_Runbook.pdf (run steps + monitoring dashboards), 2) CSV template. Monica will own the run coordination and evidence review.

Sean

Alyssa / Sean — we completed the witness run this morning and I've attached the result bundle. High-level results first:

Summary of results (witness run 2025-05-20 09:00-11:00 PT):
- Golden-set correctness: 99.2% pass across 2,000 prompts (mismatches were low-severity tokenization differences; samples included).
- Latency: p50 110ms, p90 185ms, p99 290ms.
- Throughput: steady-state 1,050 RPS sustained across three 15m windows; peak bursts hit 2,480 RPS with 92% success.
- Tail incidents: 0.3% of requests > 1s, correlated with a single GPU driver recovery event at 09:43 (logs attached).
- Error rate: 1.4% (mostly transient 503s during the GPU recovery window).

What we attached: spd-benchmark-results-20250520.csv (per-request rows), spd-witness-logs-20250520.zip (server logs, traces), checksums.txt. The CSV follows the template Sean sent. We also exported the dashboard snapshot link in the runbook.

Next steps we propose:
- Redwood to review the GPU recovery event and advise mitigation (Marissa will take the lead).
- SpeedPay to validate artifact checksums and confirm acceptance by EOD 2025-05-21.
- If accepted, we'll schedule production cutover checklist and a 72hr post-cutover monitoring window.

I'll be online for a call if you want to walk the artifacts together.

—Monica
